parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries returned.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [ListRegions](url) view.
